Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Blank pale eyes with no visible pupil; a glowing ring sigil on the brow.
  • Oversized black lacquer prayer beads; plain WOODEN staff topped with a skull finial in a brass frame — the frame is brass, the shaft is never metal.
  • Sea-monk stillness — the threat is weight and silence, never a snarl.
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
